text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD-91234. service=redis-cluster-us-west2, symptom=client_connections_exhausted, metric=redis_connected_clients hitting maxclients, node=redis-03. Auto-escalation set to P1.

Aisha: acked on PD, I'm on it. seeing spikes in accept queue and a lot of TIME_WAIT sockets in the pod logs.

Tom: oncall here, grabbing logs. can someone drop the pgbouncer pool stats? suspecting rds/pg is fine but clients are retrying hard into redis.

Raj: copying pgbouncer/redis checks I ran:
```
# redis-cli -h redis-03 info clients | egrep "connected_clients|blocked_clients"
connected_clients:10240
blocked_clients:512
# pgbouncer SHOW POOLS (excerpt)
db_main  total  used  free  waiting
main    600    590   10    1200
```

Raj: blocked_clients > 0 and connected_clients at cluster cap. looks like a client storm + some leaking connections from worker pool on a cron.

Aisha: customer impact: Support is seeing 503s for ~8% of requests that hit the cache tier. adding note to incident. Product Ops: low-latency features degraded for some tenants in us-west.

Support: seeing multiple tickets for timeouts from vanity-search and invite flows. marking impacted_customers: internal_mega_app, partner_x.

Tom: immediate mitigation plan:
- throttle ingress to redis: flip cache-fallback flag for non-critical routes (short term)
- scale redis replicas to add headroom (if possible) and bump client limit per node (careful)
- restart the offending worker job to clear leaked sockets
- add temporary pgbouncer queue-limit to shed traffic gracefully

Aisha: executing first two: toggling cache-fallback via routing feature flags now. doing a soft rollout 10% -> 100%.

Tom: scaling pgbouncer pool + restarting job. running: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment/pgbouncer --replicas=6` and `kubectl -n jobs restart job/metrics-cron`

Raj: adding a short rate-limit at the ingress LB to throttle retry storms: `curl -X POST https://infra-api/rl-config -d '{"route":"/cache/*","rps":2000}'` (applied).

Aisha: once flags hit 100% I see error rate on cache down to ~2.1% from 8.3%. latencies for cache miss increased a bit but downstream fallbacks working. :thumbsup:

PagerDuty: PD-91234 acknowledged by Aisha, escalation stopped.

SRE Lead: good quick mitigation. putting everyone on a short bridge for 35m to monitor. Please capture timeline and add to incident doc.

Tom: follow-up metrics (post-mitigation):
```
# redis-cli -h redis-03 info clients
connected_clients:4300
blocked_clients:5
# pgbouncer SHOW POOLS
main    total  used  free  waiting
main    320    210   110   12
```

Tom: looks much better. still seeing a few transient reconnect spikes from one regional customer, investigating client retry config.

Raj: note — we had a runaway cron on worker-alpha that opened many persistent connections. created PR to add connection pooling + proper close in the job: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/2987 :eyes:

Support: customers flagged as impacted have been emailed with a brief status update and ETA.

Product Ops: flagging this for post-incident review. suggested follow-ups: add circuit-breaker at client SDK, add alert for blocked_clients > 50 per node, and add playbook step to rotate worker jobs on high connection spikes.

Aisha: summary for timeline (to paste into incident doc):
- 4740023130 PD fired (redis maxclients)
- 4740023180 flags rolled for cache-fallback -> traffic shed from redis
- 4740023220 pgbouncer scaled & job restarted
- 4740023300 ingress rate-limit applied
- 4740023500 observed stabilisation; error rate reduced from 8.3% -> 2.1%

SRE Lead: marking incident as mitigated on pagerduty, leaving open for postmortem. please add RCA notes to the incident runbook. thanks team. :tada:

PagerDuty: PD-91234 status -> Mitigated by Aisha at 4740023590 (auto-close window 1h).

Tom: quick follow-ups I'll own: add blocked_clients alert, harden cron connection handling, and run a chaos test on client retries next sprint.

Aisha: closing bridge in 10m unless anyone needs extra time. huge thanks everyone. :heart:

Support: confirmed messages to two impacted customers have been acknowledged. will coordinate any refunds if needed.

incident-bot: Note: please set incident severity in doc to P1-brief and add postmortem owner: Tom.

[end of thread]
